name: keyboard-coach
description: Suggest deterministic keyboard shortcuts after mouse actions.

interface.shortDescription: Turn mouse actions into keyboard shortcut suggestions.
interface.longDescription: Identifies the clicked control through Hyprland and AT-SPI, matches it against indexed Omarchy bindings and sourced app shortcut packs, and displays the suggestion in an Omarchy banner. Unmatched clicks stay silent and are logged for coverage work.
interface.defaultPrompt: Help me extend Keyboard Coach's shortcut coverage.
